## f06819f26831

Concrete authority/description mismatch: the generator describes single-color blobs as ignored distractors, but the Racket authority considers any non-template nonzero cell as a partial candidate. A blob that shares a template color can therefore create new painted structure.

Replay with difficulty `easy`, seed `11`, sample index `1`. The 11×14 input has template colors `{3,9}` and a four-cell color-3 blob at `(8,5)`, `(9,5)`, `(9,6)`, `(10,5)`. Compared with an interpretation that ignores the distractor blob, the authority paints six additional cells:

- `(7,6)=3`
- `(8,4)=3`
- `(8,6)=9`
- `(8,7)=3`
- `(9,4)=9`
- `(10,4)=3`

Thus the advertised distractor can become a semantic seed whenever its color overlaps the template. A learner may infer a different partial-completion rule than the documentation intends. Full input, authority output, ignore-distractor counterfactual, and cell diff are retained in `checks/audit-f068-distractor.json`.
